theme: Shortest test suite covering every DFA transition
title: Covering Every DFA Transition with the Fewest Symbols
strategies: trivial: cover every transition with its own separate string (shortest path from s0 to the transition's source state, then the symbol) -- restarts from s0 every time; this IS the checker baseline

greedy: chain everything into ONE continuous string by BFS-walking, in fixed (state,symbol) table order, from the current position to the next uncovered transition's source state -- reuses the walk but is blind to graph structure, so an adversarial state-id relabelling forces long backward detours along the one-way backbone

strong: CHINESE-POSTMAN insight -- compute each state's transition in/out-degree imbalance, solve the min-cost assignment (shortest-path costs) matching surplus states to deficient states (also searching which state should be the walk's endpoint, i.e. an OPEN Eulerian trail not a closed circuit), duplicate exactly those shortest paths to rebalance the graph, then emit ONE Eulerian-trail string via Hierholzer's algorithm

headroom above strong: exact optimal min-cost flow / smarter choice of which states to leave imbalanced when duplicating paths that share sub-paths (our bitmask assignment is optimal for the stated formulation but a solver could explore alternate rebalancing decompositions)
